verdict.rationale: Motion is a SaaS task and calendar platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, and nothing shows an agent connecting to one. The pack documents only a REST API with X-API-Key auth, an llms.txt overview and a Zapier integration; these are building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
